The HealthCare Connection utilizes savings generated through the 340B Drug Pricing Program to expand access to comprehensive healthcare services for underserved and vulnerable populations in our community. Rather than distributing these funds as profit, 340B savings are reinvested into programs and services that support our mission as a Federally Qualified Health Center.

Specifically, 340B savings help offset the cost of providing care to uninsured and underinsured patients, support expanded pharmacy services, maintain medication access programs, and fund clinical staff and care coordination services that are not fully reimbursed by third-party payers. These funds also help sustain behavioral health, dental, vision, and primary care services, improve patient access through extended hours and care management, and support investments in technology, equipment, and infrastructure that enhance patient care.

As reimbursement rates often do not fully cover the cost of providing comprehensive healthcare services, 340B savings are essential to maintaining financial sustainability while allowing The HealthCare Connection to continue expanding services, improving health outcomes, and reducing barriers to care for the communities we serve.
